| ℹ️ | Open PR #39267 targets the same issue (#37647). Check whether #37647 has "help wanted", as the author has no merged PRs |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to link the issue and complete the PR template. Close it if #37647 turns out not to be "help wanted" or if #39267 is the one being pursued.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update, @Shinu-Cherian! Please link the issue in the PR description with "Fixes: #37647", and fill in the rest of the PR template: how you tested, before/after screenshots, and the self-review checklist (see the [guide on making PRs reviewable](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/reviewable-prs.html)). Please also check that the issue is labeled "help wanted" and look at #39267, which targets the same issue.
```
